rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone looks or behaves fashionably and stylishly.

example.english: They dressed fabulously today, and everyone around them was looking at them.
example.traditional: 佢今日打扮到好有型咁，周圍啲人都望住佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2 baan6 dou3 hou2 jau5 jing4 gam3 zau1 wai4 di1 jan4 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when fabulously describes strikingly beautiful appearance rather than stylish manner in general.

example.english: The bride looked fabulously beautiful, and everyone praised her during the photos.
example.traditional: 個新娘靚到不得了，影相嗰陣個個都讚佢。
example.jyutping: go3 san1 noeng4 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5 jing2 soeng2 go2 zan6 go3 go3 dou1 zaan3 keoi5
